brief.summary: Soft Scandinavian ease: clean feminine basics in natural fabrics, mostly neutral with a sky-blue or buttery accent, worn simply so the cut and the hair do the talking. Fitted tees and knits, relaxed trousers and denim, slip and midi skirts, loafers or ballet flats — pretty without being sweet.
signatures: fine-knit cardigan buttoned as a top
silhouettes: midi skirt with a short knit
